verdict.rationale: Helicone's docs describe a first-party Playground where you build and iterate on prompts, save versions with commit history, and use variables in system prompts, messages and tool schemas. The 100+ gateway models suggest real-model execution. However, no evidence explicitly ties the Playground to running against those real models or to filling in variable values interactively, so coverage of the full story is incomplete. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the Playground runs prompts against live provider models with model switching, documented variable input or test-value substitution inside the Playground, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the Playground workflow

support.subject: As a developer, I can iterate on prompts in a playground against real models and variables

citations.quote: Playground: Rapidly test and iterate on prompts, sessions and traces in our UI.
Build a prompt in the Playground. Save any prompt with clear commit histories and tags.
Use variables anywhere - system prompts, messages, even tool schemas - for truly reusable prompts
Switch between 100+ models by just changing the model name
